title: PC 429: Rooftop Gardens and Landscaping
officialText:
429.1 Water supply.

Where a connection to an approved water supply is required by Section 318.5 of the New York City Fire Code for rooftop gardens or landscaping exceeding 250 square feet (23 m 2 ), an approved fixture shall be provided for connection to such water supply in accordance with this code.
